summary: After analysis the assistant flags anti-patterns, failure causes and best-practice gaps; ask 'How do I fix this error?' or 'Refactor this task to follow best practices' for corrected code, apply it, then ask 'Does this look correct now?' to re-run ansible_lint.
questions: How do I get the AI assistant to fix my playbook?
Refactor an Ansible task to follow best practices with Copilot
How do I confirm the fixes resolved the issues?
